questions.question: In a PoE installation, which device is the powered device when an AP is attached to a PoE switch?
questions.explanation: The access point consumes power, while the switch supplies it.

option_explanations.A: Receiving Ethernet frames does not make a device the PoE power consumer.
option_explanations.B: The switch is the power sourcing equipment in this setup.
option_explanations.C: The access point consumes power, while the switch supplies it.
option_explanations.D: A passive patch panel does not consume the PoE allocation.

questions.question: What can a standards-compatible PoE switch supply on the AP's copper Ethernet cable?
questions.explanation: PoE combines DC power delivery and Ethernet communications on the supported copper cable.

option_explanations.A: A compatible PoE port can also source electrical power.
option_explanations.B: PoE combines DC power delivery and Ethernet communications on the supported copper cable.
option_explanations.C: The cable continues to carry Ethernet data.
option_explanations.D: This link uses copper signaling rather than optical signals.

questions.question: A non-PoE switch must connect to a PoE-powered camera. Where does a compatible midspan injector go?

options.A: In parallel with the camera outside its data path
options.C: Between the switch and its upstream router
options.D: In line between the switch and camera

questions.explanation: The injector accepts data on the upstream side and supplies data plus power toward the camera.

option_explanations.A: A midspan must inject power onto the cable in the camera's Ethernet path.
option_explanations.B: The console port is not the camera's Ethernet path.
option_explanations.C: An injector on the upstream link cannot send power through a non-PoE switch to the camera port.
option_explanations.D: The injector accepts data on the upstream side and supplies data plus power toward the camera.

questions.question: After recabling, a camera has no power. The injector's PoE output is connected to a non-PoE switch, and the camera is connected to its data-only input. How should the engineer reconnect the cables?

options.A: Connect both devices to data in through a splitter
options.B: Move the injector to the switch's upstream uplink
options.C: Connect the camera to PoE out and the switch to data in
options.D: Leave the switch on PoE out and enable full duplex

questions.explanation: The power output has to face the powered camera. The data-only input connects to the non-PoE switch.

option_explanations.A: A data-only input does not deliver the required power.
option_explanations.B: Moving the injector upstream leaves the camera without a powered cable.
option_explanations.C: The power output has to face the powered camera. The data-only input connects to the non-PoE switch.
option_explanations.D: Duplex settings cannot make the data-only input source power.

questions.question: A switch allows 60 W of PoE allocation and has already reserved 50 W. A new device requires a 15 W allocation. What explains a power denial?

options.A: The device requires less power than the remaining budget
options.C: The remaining 10 W guarantees the device can draw 15 W

questions.explanation: The switch cannot reserve 15 W from a budget with only 10 W available.

option_explanations.A: The required 15 W is greater than the 10 W remaining.
option_explanations.B: The existing 50 W reservations consume budget.
option_explanations.C: An allocation of 10 W cannot meet a 15 W request.
option_explanations.D: The switch cannot reserve 15 W from a budget with only 10 W available.

questions.question: A PoE switch has ample aggregate budget but its port cannot deliver the AP's specified power. What determines whether that port is suitable?

options.B: Only the link's negotiated data rate
options.C: Only the total chassis power budget
options.D: The port's supported PoE capability and power limit

questions.explanation: Both the port's supply capability and the available system budget must meet the device's requirements.

option_explanations.A: The management mask does not determine the power the switch can provide.
option_explanations.B: Negotiated link speed is independent of the supported PoE power level.
option_explanations.C: Aggregate capacity does not override the individual port's limit.
option_explanations.D: Both the port's supply capability and the available system budget must meet the device's requirements.

questions.question: A camera, its non-PoE switch and a separate injector must stay usable during a brief utility outage. The switch is already on UPS power. What additional connection protects the camera’s power path?

options.A: Connect the injector data input to a passive patch panel
options.B: Move the camera data cable to a second non-PoE switch port
options.C: Connect the injector power input to the UPS
options.D: Configure the switch port to keep its DHCP lease

questions.explanation: The separately powered injector must stay energized for the camera to keep receiving power.

option_explanations.A: The patch panel does not supply or back up the injector's power input.
option_explanations.B: A second non-PoE port still provides no backup power for the camera.
option_explanations.C: The separately powered injector must stay energized for the camera to keep receiving power.
option_explanations.D: A DHCP lease has no role in electrical power delivery.

questions.question: A powered AP lights up but the switch reports no Ethernet link. Which conclusion is justified?

options.A: The uplink routing table has a connected AP route
options.B: Power delivery alone does not establish Ethernet forwarding
options.C: The AP has received and acknowledged a DHCP lease
options.D: The switch has learned the AP's MAC address

questions.explanation: The power and data functions have distinct status. Investigate the data path and link state.

option_explanations.A: Being powered does not show that the AP is reachable at Layer 3.
option_explanations.B: The power and data functions have distinct status. Investigate the data path and link state.
option_explanations.C: With no Ethernet link, there is no evidence of a completed DHCP exchange.
option_explanations.D: Power alone does not prove the switch received a frame from the AP.

questions.question: Select TWO. A camera requires standards-compatible PoE. Which deployments can supply power while connecting the camera to the wired LAN?

options.A: Connect it through a passive patch panel to a non-PoE switch
options.B: Connect it directly to a non-PoE switch using a crossover cable
options.C: Use a compatible midspan injector with a non-PoE switch
options.D: Connect it directly to a compatible PoE switch port

questions.explanation: An injector or a PoE switch can supply power. Cabling and patch panels only carry whatever the upstream device supplies.

option_explanations.A: A passive patch panel cannot add power to a link from a non-PoE switch.
option_explanations.B: A crossover cable changes pair routing but cannot produce power.
option_explanations.C: A compatible midspan adds power inline while passing the switch's Ethernet data.
option_explanations.D: A compatible PoE switch port directly supplies both electrical power and the Ethernet link.

questions.question: An AP functions from a known-good compatible injector and the same cable, but a PoE switch denies power. Its log reports insufficient budget. Which corrective action addresses the reported constraint?

options.A: Free enough system PoE allocation or move the AP to a compatible source with capacity
options.B: Set full duplex on the switch's uplink
options.C: Change the AP's default gateway to the switch management address
options.D: Clear the AP's ARP entry on the router

questions.explanation: Testing with independent power isolates the report from basic AP failure. The switch must have enough available power allocation.

option_explanations.A: Testing with independent power isolates the report from basic AP failure. The switch must have enough available power allocation.
option_explanations.B: Changing uplink duplex does not increase the available PoE allocation.
option_explanations.C: Changing the gateway affects routing only after the AP is operating.
option_explanations.D: Clearing ARP does not release any reserved PoE watts.
